name: Bottega No.13
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bottega No.13 in Neustift im Stubaital**

Discover the heart of Tyrolean hospitality in this charming spot nestled in the picturesque **Stubaital**. At **Bottega No.13**, we blend rustic warmth with modern flair, offering you an unforgettable experience in the midst of the Alps.

Indulge in our carefully crafted dishes, where fresh, local ingredients take center stage. From hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** to savory **Tiroler Gröstl**, every bite tells a story of tradition and passion.

After your meal, unwind with a selection of fine wines or a comforting **Schnaps**—perfect for toasting to your time in this stunning valley.

Whether you're here for adventure or relaxation, **Bottega No.13** is your gateway to the soul of **Tirol**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, we’re your ideal retreat after a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the breathtaking landscapes of the **Stubai Alps**.

Come, let us welcome you with open arms—and a plate of deliciousness. **Willkommen in Neustift im Stubaital!**
